build_scope: Installed unsigned Linux debug Debian package on a hosted Xvfb runner
accounting_scope: Fresh cgroup v2 leaf containing the app and its descendants, including the final work of the admission launcher. Shared services outside the leaf are excluded. Memory counters are cgroup-charged bytes and kernel peak watermarks.
timing_scope: Fresh app and WebView processes launch with unflushed system caches. Startup includes automation from WebDriver session POST through observed UI readiness. Quiet CPU windows span first and last cgroup sample-command midpoints, with no WebDriver calls after readiness until both windows finish. The early window can include work deferred from startup.
attribution_scope: Process CPU deltas use Linux clock ticks for matching PID, start time, executable and effective UID at each window's endpoints. Membership commands bracket the group samples and have a separate midpoint span. Processes missing at either endpoint or present only between endpoints can contribute to group totals without appearing in process deltas.
